title: Nevers to La Vieuville, St-Aignan, 30 Sept 1587 (BnF fr. 3975 fol. 101, DECODE R4289)

steps.what: DECODE R4289 images fetched with the saved cookie; Gallica ark of fr. 3975 found (btv1b90605473, f.101r = canvas 185).
Tomokiyo nevers.htm: no reading of this letter; hidden note on the 31 Aug 1587 sibling (fr. 3416 f.53v) where key no.11 failed.
Tested key no. 12 (Apr 1587, fr. 3995 f.26): a symbol alphabet unlike the letter.
Read key no. 16 (1587, fr. 3995 f.32v) in full; its code numbers fit the letter (42 eschevins, 43 maire de ville) and it reads Tomokiyo's sibling snippet ('vostre main', 'parle').
Whole letter a cipher: ruled out; most is clear French in a hasty hand, with ciphered runs inserted.
Straight no.16 reading of the run 'd65 i8 th6 6725' gives no French; clear text only ~30-40% legible at the zoom tried.
Gomberville, Memoires du duc de Nevers (1665) part 1 on Gallica searched (Vieuville, Aignan): letter not printed there.
Fetched sibling fr. 3416 ff. 52v-53r (Gallica btv1b9058240c canvas 62): same hand, clear text with code numbers, no decipherment; apparent margin glosses are line-ends from the facing page.
Glyph-level transcription of 19 lines of f.101r (ct_101r.txt, ~900 glyphs, 28 signs, ~60% per-glyph confidence).
Raw transcription scored as French: -5.67/char vs shuffled -7.86 and real French ~-1.5; not clear French as transcribed.
Homophonic substitution anneal with unigram-KL penalty (solve2.py), 8 restarts: best -4.53/char, no French.
control.py: French enciphered homophonically with glyph noise; solve2 recovers it at 0% and 20% noise, fails at 40% even on 4000 chars; the real transcription scores like the 40% case.
Key no.16 applied directly to the f.101r transcription: 74% glyph coverage, decrypt -7.68/char (worse than shuffled).
Merged confusable glyph classes (u/n/m/w, e/c/r) and re-ran the anneal: best -4.76/char, no French.
Re-read key no. 16's alphabet from the sheet image (rotated): s = i/5, not i/h; key16.txt corrected.
Swept ff. 101r-102v at native resolution in strips: code numbers and runs only on f.101v and f.102v; ~37 items listed with key-16 values and grades in items.tsv.
Code numbers read with key no. 16: 42/43 eschevins/maire de ville, 63(bar) La Vieuville x3, 2(bar) Rethelois, 48 chasteau, 30 artillerie; barred vs plain undecided where no bar is visible.

runs.py: every key-16 reading of runs A (18 signs), B (8), C (7) with ambiguous glyphs expanded, scored with fr-1530-despatches alone and inside the clear context: no French (best 'si et rou essance de si', 'sie de lan', 'requelae').
Gomberville Memoires part 2 (Google Books H2eV4wAmIr0C) searched for Vieuville/Vieville/Vieuuille/Aignan; BnF fr. 4715/4716 notices; DECODE document list: letter not printed, no transcription.
Next leaves of fr. 3975 checked: f.103 (to the Queen Mother, 1 Oct 1587) and f.127 (to La Vieuville, 23 Oct 1587): no decipherment.
Looked for a better image: DECODE's R4289 images are crops of the same Gallica microfilm; Gallica SRU lists no other (colour) digitisation of fr. 3975.

outcome.method_basis: Tomokiyo's Nevers key no. 16 (fr. 3995 f. 32v) matched the code numbers only (42 eschevins, 43 maire de ville, 63 La Vieuville); the letter runs and the clear text stay unread on the only microfilm images.

gaps.item: letter text ff. 101r-102v (~110 lines of clear French)
code numbers without a visible bar (28, 29, 33-35, 36, 80)

outcome.notes: Code numbers identified against key no. 16 only; the letter text and the three letter runs are unread. fraction_read counts the run signs and the letter text, neither of which reads.
